jobs.title: Java Full Stack Developer
jobs.text: Java Full Stack Developer Job Requirements Role and Responsibility Brief We are looking for a highly motivated Full Stack Developer to join the engineering team. The engineer will be responsible for designing, developing, and maintaining scalable web applications, microservices, APIs, and cloud-native solutions that power device management, analytics, workflow automation, and digital employee experience capabilities. The ideal candidate should possess strong expertise in modern front-end frameworks, backend service development, API-first architecture, cloud platforms, DevOps, Agile delivery practices and must have an AI first mindset. Work Experience Years of Experience: 4-6years Must Have Skill Front-End Development · Design and develop responsive, enterprise-grade web applications. · Pro
